note: Negatives are mutations of the valid manifest; validMutations are positive controls proving a rule is not simply 'reject everything http'.

cases.why: a 2.0 document without profileVersion is indistinguishable from 1.0
content addressing without a hash cannot support promotion or rollback by pointer
the harness set is closed at 12; a thirteenth id must fail, not warn
plain http to a non-loopback host must be rejected
fan-out above 5 exceeds merge capacity; the limit must be schema-enforced, not prose
prompts are harness-side; smuggling one into the protocol must fail
depth above 2 is rejected by policy before it becomes a runaway chain
the curator may only propose; auto-promotion is the rejected R1 design
a truncated hash must not be accepted as content addressing
SSE-only transport is not a declared profile transport; 2026-07-28 streamable-http is
duplicate skills would ship twice with two different hashes to two targets
failurePolicy is a closed set: silent-ignore is exactly the failure this release forbids
a 2.0 document carries content-addressed skill objects; a bare 1.0 path is produced only by projection

validMutations.why: loopback http is allowed only when the manifest says so explicitly
